cues.show: You with the guitar, the drill's tab on screen.
cues.say: This is a warm-up for the hand on the neck. Each finger gets its own fret, and the fingers go down one at a time.

cues.show: Point at the tab, then the finger numbers under it.
cues.say: The tab shows the frets to play, and the numbers under it show which finger plays each one.

cues.show: Fretting hand close up. Play the pattern on one string without the tool, slowly.
cues.say: Play one note with each finger, in the order on the screen. Keep each finger down until the next one lands.

cues.show: Fretting hand close up. Play the pattern on one string without the tool, slowly.
cues.say: Your thumb sits behind the neck, about under your second finger.

cues.show: Press the Play button and play along across all six strings.
cues.say: Press the Play button below to start the metronome and the notes. It starts straight away, with one note on each beat.

cues.show: Press the Play button and play along across all six strings.
cues.say: Play along, and move to the next string when the tab does.

cues.show: Stop, open the hand and shake it out.
cues.say: _Stop and shake your hand out as soon as it feels tight or it hurts._

cues.show: Stop, open the hand and shake it out.
cues.say: Practice until the order is in your muscle memory: your fingers go without you thinking about them.

cues.show: Press Notes to mute the notes, then play with only the click. Then play it backwards.
cues.say: Try things with it. Press Notes below to mute the notes and play with only the metronome.

cues.show: Press Notes to mute the notes, then play with only the click. Then play it backwards.
cues.say: Play the same order coming back down, from your little finger to your first.

cues.show: Press Notes to mute the notes, then play with only the click. Then play it backwards.
cues.say: Move your hand to another fret and play it there: higher up the neck the frets are closer together.
